basic_details.job_title: Purnea Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 support staff posts (1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon / Orderly) in the Evening Court of Purnea Judgeship. These posts are filled on a contractual basis. The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Purnea has issued the notice. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Purnea, Bihar - 854301 on or before 30 November 2026. You can deliver the application in person or send it by registered post.

content_sections.heading: About Purnea Civil Court
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Purnea heads the Purnea Judgeship in Bihar. The judgeship includes the Civil Court, Purnea and the Sub-Divisional Civil Courts at Banmankhi, Baisi and Dhamdaha. This recruitment is for support staff in the Evening Court of the Purnea Judgeship. The notice was circulated to all judgeships of Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to this address: The Principal District and Sessions Judge, Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Purnea, Bihar - 854301. Mode: You can deliver the application personally, which the form calls physical mode. You can also send it through registered post. Deadline: The application must reach the office on or before 30 November 2026. The notice counts the date of receipt, not the date of dispatch. Form: Use the sample application form annexed to the notice, titled "Application Form for Engagement of Support Staff in the Evening Court, Civil Court, Purnea". Post choice: In the "Post Applied For" box, tick one post only: Stenographer, Clerk or Peon / Orderly. Envelope: The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope. The application form has three parts: Part A (Personal details): name in block letters, father's / husband's name, mother's name and date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation Certificate. It also asks for age as on 22-11-2026, sex, marital status, nationality, Aadhaar Number (mandatory), date of retirement, and the post you retired from with the name of the judgeship. Part B (Eligibility and other particulars): whether the Civil Surgeon's medical fitness certificate is attached. It also asks whether any F.I.R. or criminal case is registered or pending against you, and whether any departmental proceeding was conducted. If you answer "Yes" to either question, give brief details on a separate sheet. Part C (Address and contact): permanent and correspondence address (village / mohalla, P.O., P.S., district, PIN, state), mobile number and alternate mobile number. You must also sign an undertaking / declaration. In it you state that: The declaration also says that false information may lead to rejection. You undertake to check the official website for updates and to appear for the recruitment process at your own cost.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice prints one rule for the pay of all three posts. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No amount is printed. The applicant must be retired staff of the Civil Courts. Only retired court staff who retired within the last three years will be considered, "prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna". The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to carry out the duties of the post. A medical fitness certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon / C.M.O. must be enclosed with the application form. The applicant must have satisfactory service records. The applicant should not have received any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for any of the posts. It also does not give an age limit, although the form asks for your age as on 22-11-2026. For the exact eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attach these documents, as listed in the form: Two self-attested passport-size photographs Proof of Date of Birth / Matriculation Certificate Aadhaar Card Retirement / Service Certificate and proof of date of retirement Medical Fitness Certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon (the notice also accepts one from the C.M.O.) Documents relating to any departmental proceeding / criminal case, if applicable Any other document (optional, as named by the applicant)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Purnea Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies in the Evening Court of Purnea Judgeship: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon / Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Purnea on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Purnea Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired staff of the Civil Courts can apply. They must have retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: A Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. A Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice does not print an amount. Remuneration is governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Purnea Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the annexed application form and attach the listed documents. Then deliver it personally or send it by registered post to the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Purnea, Bihar - 854301.

faq.question: Q7. Is a medical certificate needed?
faq.answer: Yes. A medical fitness certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon / C.M.O. must be enclosed with the application form.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual and can be terminated at any time. It gives no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must work for a minimum of 5 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: The application form asks applicants to tick one post: Stenographer, Clerk or Peon / Orderly.
